reviews.text: I recently purchased a home with the help of Laura Weaver with Steve Hawkins Custom Homes, and the experience was outstanding from start to finish. Laura’s professionalism, clear communication, and genuine dedication made the entire process smooth and enjoyable. I’m truly grateful for her support and would happily recommend Laura to anyone looking to purchase a home.
reviews.author: Anthony Nguyen

reviews.text:
If I could give 10 stars I would.
Steve has demonstrated over and over that he is a man of integrity, keeps his word and follows through to see that we were taken care of. We purchased a new 4 bedroom home from him with Matt and his team worked diligently to get us through the process to get all our financing done and  close in 15 days and on the day we needed to be able to move in right away.
Great communication and helping us through all the steps with ease.
Where do you see that happen?
When I say it seemed sweat-less and stress free, that’s an understatement.
I would recommend and do recommend anyone looking to get into a new home, look no further.
We love our new home inside and out. The extra wide driveway so our car doors aren’t hitting each other is nice.  We love the features and quality put into the construction, especially the materials for energy efficiency which I know will make a big difference with Texas heat.
Steve still calls in to check on us and to see if there’s anything we need.
Again where do you see that happen?
Thank you Steve and to all your team.
What a BLESSING you are.
reviews.author: Scott Tripp

reviews.text:
Welcome Home???
The view from my back porch the day after closing.  These photos represent how I felt working with Hawkins Homes during this build. Not only did I have to clean my home (inside and out), but I had to pick trash out of the yard and mow it, too.  What should have been a happy day reminded me of all the work I needed to do to move into my "brand new home."

If you are not in a hurry to move; if you don't have standards; or you like being lied to...then you will not mind this builder.  Otherwise, BUYER BEWARE!

After the sales pitch, this build was a struggle from start to finish.
reviews.author: Nikita Watts

reviews.text: Worst home building experience ever...  Our first impression was that this company cared, but once we brought up things promised to us, and they realized they could get a boat load more money if we backed out, it was all downhill from there...  We've been in the house for about 4 months, and we've had multiple issues, but since this one is fresh I though I'd share (I was afraid to complain about the other issues until the 1 year warranty period ended, but I now realize we won't be getting any support so why not start now).  So according to GC, the attached pictures reflect a proper draining property...  Funny that no other neighbors around us are having this issue.  Love this company!  My advice to anyone looking to build a home, choose anyone else and run far far away from the Hawkins.
reviews.author: Ryan Peterson

reviews.text: We have built five custom homes with Hawkins Custom Homes.  Each has been of superior quality.  Their crews are detailed, polite, and timely.  They work together with the homeowner to achieve exactly what they want. This is a family run business who truly cares about the quality and workmanship they put out. We just can't say enough, other than hopefully they will be building our next home!
reviews.author: Blessings Candles

reviews.text: Working with Laura at Steve Hawkins Custom Homes has been tremendous! She made my home building process smooth. Laura paid close attention to detail and responded immediately to any requests and inquiries. From selections to coordinating vendors, Laura was there every step of the way. It is with high regard that I recommend Laura, Jay, and Steve Custom Homes.
reviews.author: Shannon Fletcher

reviews.text: Initially we thought Steve Hawkins homes was going to be the best experience ever. Unfortunately they were not immune to the stereo types of dealing with home builders. We have tried for a year and half to get several warranty items fixed but to no avail. Doug has been full of I’m sorry’s with no results. Tried calling to speak with Laura, Steve, and anybody else but never a call back. Oh and numerous issues durning the actual build as well. This company masquerades as a family wholesome company, but it’s clear their main value is money first service never. Be cautious of this builder, they will promise a lot but deliver very little.
reviews.author: Michael Escobar

reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of showing my buyers a few Steve Hawkins Custom Homes and my buyers fell in love with one.  It was new construction and there were a few things that needed to be finished prior to closing.  Laura Weaver with Steve Hawkins Custom Homes was so easy to work with and was prompt in taking care of our calls, emails and concerns.  She was on the ball.  My job as a Realtor is to get my buyers to the closing table as stress free as possible and to ensure it is a pleasant experience for all.  This one had ZERO stress or concerns and I contribute that to the professionals involved.  I love to partner with professionals who love their jobs like I love mine.
Thank you Laura Weaver and Steve Hawkins Custom Homes.
reviews.author: Peggy Villagomez

reviews.text: I recently purchased a home with the help of Laura Weaver with Steve Hawkins Custom Homes, and the experience was outstanding from start to finish. Laura’s professionalism, clear communication, and genuine dedication made the entire process smooth and enjoyable. I’m truly grateful for her support and would happily recommend Laura to anyone looking to purchase a home.

If I could give 10 stars I would.
Steve has demonstrated over and over that he is a man of integrity, keeps his word and follows through to see that we were taken care of. We purchased a new 4 bedroom home from him with Matt and his team worked diligently to get us through the process to get all our financing done and  close in 15 days and on the day we needed to be able to move in right away.
Great communication and helping us through all the steps with ease.
Where do you see that happen?
When

Welcome Home???
The view from my back porch the day after closing.  These photos represent how I felt working with Hawkins Homes during this build. Not only did I have to clean my home (inside and out), but I had to pick trash out of the yard and mow it, too.  What should have been a happy day reminded me of all the work I needed to do to move into my "brand new home."

If you are not in a hurry to move; if you don't have standards; or you like being lied to...then you will not mind this builder

Worst home building experience ever...  Our first impression was that this company cared, but once we brought up things promised to us, and they realized they could get a boat load more money if we backed out, it was all downhill from there...  We've been in the house for about 4 months, and we've had multiple issues, but since this one is fresh I though I'd share (I was afraid to complain about the other issues until the 1 year warranty period ended, but I now realize we won't be getting any su

We have built five custom homes with Hawkins Custom Homes.  Each has been of superior quality.  Their crews are detailed, polite, and timely.  They work together with the homeowner to achieve exactly what they want. This is a family run business who truly cares about the quality and workmanship they put out. We just can't say enough, other than hopefully they will be building our next home!

Working with Laura at Steve Hawkins Custom Homes has been tremendous! She made my home building process smooth. Laura paid close attention to detail and responded immediately to any requests and inquiries. From selections to coordinating vendors, Laura was there every step of the way. It is with high regard that I recommend Laura, Jay, and Steve Custom Homes.

data.summary: The reviews present a mixed but concerning picture. There is strong evidence of authentic negative experiences detailing consistent post-sale and warranty issues. The positive reviews show some authentic signals but are undermined by the duplication of text across profiles, suggesting possible review manipulation or solicitation. The complete absence of mid-range (3-4 star) reviews is atypical and polarizing.
fake_signals: Identical 5-star reviews posted on both Google profiles (Local and HQ) by different names/Anonymous
Generic, corporate-sounding praise in multiple 5-star reviews
Lack of 3-4 star reviews creates a polarized rating distribution
authentic_signals: Negative reviews contain specific, credible details (names like Doug, Laura, Steve; warranty periods; trash in yard)
Positive reviews mention specific staff (Laura, Matt, Joel, Jay) and project details (4-bedroom home, modifications)
Company has been in business for 44 years, suggesting a real operational history
BBB A+ rating with accreditation since 2019 indicates complaint resolution
data.discrepancy_explanation: Limited platform data available. Google rating is moderate, BBB rating is high, but no contradictory low ratings from other major platforms.
